summary: Liverpool brought Club Brugge’s impressive run in the Champions League to an abrupt halt on a bitterly cold night in Belgium with an exhibition of outstanding finishing and composed defending.
Alexander Isak took his tally for the season into double figures and Florian Wirtz maintained his fine form by scoring for a third successive club game.

Andoni Iraola’s side are building momentum at the right time.Isak struck an excellent brace to move to ten goals for the season while Liverpool’s clean sheet will also have encouraged Iraola against a previously free-scoring Brugge team.

summary: 16 teams will qualify for the playoffs, down from 18Best-of-three format eliminated in first roundSemi-finals, MLS Cup will be single-eliminationThe 2026 MLS Cup playoffs have only just begun, but the league is already finalizing another change to its postseason format.Beginning with the 2027-28 season, MLS will eliminate its short-lived wild card round to condense the playoff field to 16 teams and also get rid of the best-of-three format for the first round, sources confirmed to the Guardian after an earlier report by The Athletic.

stories.title: MLB sues players’ association in order to ensure lockout is declared legal
summary: League looks to head off antitrust threat by MLBPALockout a looming likelihood due to salary cap disputeMLB sued its players’ association in federal court on Wednesday, asking that its likely lockout next week be declared legal and trying to head off any attempt by the union to decertify and challenge the work stoppage with an antitrust case.In a 38-page complaint filed in US District Court in Manhattan, MLB and the corporate entities owning its 30 teams sued the Major League Baseball Players Association (MLBPA) and the eight players on the union’s executive subcommittee, including record-setting pitcher Tarik Skubal.

stories.title: Gukesh and Sindarov draw Game 2 of world chess championship in just 20 moves
summary: Game 2 ends by threefold repetition in 1hr 57minWorld champion opens with the London SystemSindarov plays with white in Game 3 on ThursdayAll your Gukesh v Sindarov questions, answeredIndia’s Gukesh Dommaraju and Uzbekistan’s Javokhir Sindarov drew the second game of their world chess championship match in only 20 moves and 1hr 57min on Wednesday, leaving the score level at 1–all at the Fondation Martin Bodmer in the Geneva suburbs.The quiet encounter was one of the shortest classical world title games since the sport’s rival championships were reunified in 2006 and the first to finish in under two hours since Ding Liren and Ian Nepomniachtchi drew their 11th game in just over 100 minutes in Astana in 2023.
